_comment: Known-latest IT firmware index for HBAviewer. Keyed by BOARD, not chipset -- one chip maps to multiple boards with incompatible images. 'confidence: verify' means the version is unconfirmed and must be checked against Broadcom before driving any update-available logic. 'it_capable: false' means the part is RAID-on-Chip and has no IT firmware at any version; surface that as a distinct state, not as a failed lookup.

SAS9211-8i.notes: OEM variants require crossflash to generic LSI IT image, not a simple upgrade. P20 is the final branch; 20.00.04.00 had known defects, 20.00.07.00 is the recommended terminal version.

SAS9300-8i.notes: Versions below 16.00.12.00 have a controller-reset bug affecting SATA drives. Distributed via iXsystems rather than Broadcom's public download page.

SAS9300-16i.notes: Dual-controller board. Flash with -fwall rather than -f or only one IOC updates.

SAS9305-16i.notes: SAS3216 treated as an IT-capable IOC by symmetry with the confirmed SAS3224, not from a card. Downgrade this board's confidence if a 9305-16i ever contradicts it.

SAS9305-24i.notes: NOT interchangeable with the 16i image despite the shared P16.12 label. SAS3224 confirmed as an IT-capable IOC (not RAID-on-Chip) from a live card: lsiutil reports MPTFW-15.00.00.00-IT with 15 JBOD drives attached.

HBA 9400-8i.notes: Tri-mode HBA ships a single firmware image; no IT/IR split. Flash via storcli /cx download file=. Version inferred from sibling 9400-16i; confirm separately.

rom_profiles._comment: Same FW version ships in multiple capability profiles. Compare versions WITHIN a profile; switching profiles is a capability change, not an upgrade.

HBA 9400-16i.notes: Confirmed to exist on a live card; NOT confirmed as the newest Broadcom release. Only IT firmware is published for this board.

rom_profiles._comment: Multipath profiles sit on a SEPARATE version track (15.x), not an older release of the 21.x track. A 15.00.01.00 card on a multipath profile is correctly configured, NOT out of date.

HBA 9405W-16i.notes: 21.00.00.00 sourced from a Broadcom download-search link whose filter names the 9400-8i, not this board -- treat as unconfirmed. Multipath package versions trace to Broadcom KB 1211211122774.

HBA 9500-8i.notes: Believed to have no legacy option ROM; null BIOS is expected, not missing data. Confirm. Profile split (SAS/SATA vs Mixed NVMe) unconfirmed for this generation.

HBA 9500-16i.notes: Believed to have no legacy option ROM; null BIOS is expected, not missing data. Confirm. Profile split unconfirmed for this generation.

no_it_firmware._comment: RAID-on-Chip parts. No IT firmware exists at any version and they cannot be crossflashed. Detect and report explicitly.

multipath_track._comment: Broadcom publishes separate multi-path firmware for 9300, 9302, 9305, 9400, and 9405W (KB 1211211122774). These run their own version numbering, independent of the standard branch. A board in an external multi-path configuration may correctly report a version far below its standard-track 'latest'.
multipath_track.status: KB page contents not yet retrieved -- package list and per-board versions unknown. The standard-track 'confirmed' versions on the affected boards are only valid for non-multipath configurations.
multipath_track.app_guidance: Do not report a board as out-of-date when its configuration is unknown and it appears in affected_boards. Detect external/multipath topology first, or suppress the comparison.

branches._comment: Companion BIOS/UEFI versions are properties of the firmware branch, not the board. A complete flash set is FW + NVDATA + BIOS + UEFI BSD; NVDATA remains board-specific.

P16.notes: Companion versions confirmed on two boards and assumed branch-wide for the rest. Verify before treating an inferred board's BIOS as stale.

P24.notes: Ships in multiple ROM profiles (SAS/SATA-only, Mixed NVMe) at the same version number. A version match alone does not mean the correct image is installed. Not known to be terminal -- newer releases may exist.

P28.notes: Latest Broadcom retail package for SAS3808/3816. Legacy option ROM believed absent on this generation. Not known to be terminal.

P21.notes: Standard tri-mode track only. Multipath profiles for this board run a separate 15.x track and are not comparable to this version.

P20.notes: Companion BIOS/UEFI unconfirmed. sas2flash reports no FW Package Build field on this generation.

parser_notes._comment: Generation-specific quirks in storcli/sas3flash output that affect lookup and health parsing.
parser_notes.board_name_convention: SAS3 and earlier report as 'SAS9305-24i' style. SAS3.5 (9400/9500) report as 'HBA 9400-16i' style. Normalize both before keying, or match on PCI device+subdevice ID instead.
parser_notes.bios_field_compound: On 9400-generation cards 'Bios Version' is underscore-joined BIOS and FW package, e.g. '09.47.00.00_24.00.00.00'. Split on '_' and take the first field as BIOS.
parser_notes.personality_unsupported: 'storcli /cx show personality' returns Status = Failure / 'Un-supported Command' on 9400 HBAs. This is expected, not a fault. Do not map to a degraded or unknown health state.
parser_notes.thermal_source: Check 'Temperature Sensor for ROC' and 'Temperature Sensor for Controller' before reading a temperature. On 9400 HBAs the ROC sensor is present and the controller sensor is absent; read 'ROC temperature(Degree Celcius)'. If both are absent, the thermal sub-indicator must return unknown rather than 0.
parser_notes.version_prefix_is_not_a_branch_check: DO NOT infer branch from the leading version pair. Special-purpose profiles run their own version tracks -- a 9405W-16i on an IT Nexus multipath profile correctly reports 15.00.01.00 while the standard track is 21.x. Resolve the profile first, then compare within that track only.
parser_notes.nvdata_format_varies: NVDATA is not consistently a decimal dotted quad. Observed forms include '24.00.00.22' (9400) and hex-style '0F.0b.91.xx' (9405W multipath profiles). Parse as an opaque string; do not coerce to numeric or version-compare it.
parser_notes.rom_profile_detection: On 9400-generation cards the installed ROM profile (SAS/SATA vs Mixed NVMe) is not clearly exposed by storcli. Report profile as unknown rather than inferring it, and do not present a single 'latest firmware' download for these boards -- offering the wrong profile can silently remove NVMe support.
parser_notes.jbod_capability_flag: 'Support JBOD = No' on a 9400 HBA does not indicate IR mode. Drives still enumerate as JBOD. Do not infer personality from this flag.
